items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and continue the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation. Do not approve new spend, monetization expansion, forecasts, ROI claims, margin claims, or queue work based on current financial evidence. Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21; $4.92 is an aggregate provider row and cannot be assigned to any site. Named tracking rows show clicks but $0 attributed commission, which is not proof of zero total revenue. AI usage cost is $922.381 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28, but the revenue window covers only 2026-09-21, so AI payback, ROI, and contribution margin are not calculable. Infrastructure, labor, other operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, monthly limits, and approved cost-to-learn thresholds are not recorded; these remain unknown, not zero. Minimum finance artifact: a dated reconciliation of all 18 named tracking rows plus the aggregate row against matching-period revenue, ordered/shipped items, AI cost, infrastructure and other costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and a learning threshold. Continue only the existing reconciliation work item; create no duplicate telemetry or proposal.

Push back on vanity metrics: the 14,410 SEO impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions across 39 sites support prioritization only; they do not establish revenue, contribution margin, attribution, or causal lift. Do not extrapolate the one-day $4.92 commission into a monthly forecast. Preserve the existing affiliate-tag, stale-reference, attribution, measurement, and failure-repair work only when it does not expand spend or telemetry.
